vocabulary.meaning_en: a word that sounds the same as another word but has a different meaning and spelling
vocabulary.meaning_ar: كلمة تُنطق مثل أخرى وتختلف في الكتابة والمعنى

vocabulary.meaning_en: a word written the same as another word but with a different meaning
vocabulary.meaning_ar: كلمة تُكتب مثل أخرى ويختلف معناها

vocabulary.meaning_en: the words and situation around a word that show its meaning
vocabulary.note_ar: السياق يحدد معنى الكلمات المتشابهة في النطق
vocabulary.note_en: Context tells you which homophone is meant.
vocabulary.example: Use the context to understand the word.

vocabulary.meaning_en: one = the number 1; won = past of win
two = 2; to = direction or infinitive; too = more than you want, or also
vocabulary.example: The two coffees are too hot to drink.

vocabulary.meaning_en: your = belongs to you; you're = you are
vocabulary.example: You're right; your car is very clean.

vocabulary.meaning_en: brake = the pedal that stops a car; break = to damage something into pieces
vocabulary.example: Put on the brakes! Don't break the glass.

vocabulary.meaning_en: bear = a large wild animal; bare = with nothing on it, empty
vocabulary.example: We saw a bear. The fridge is bare.

vocabulary.meaning_en: weather = sun, rain, wind; whether = if
vocabulary.example: Whether the weather is good or not, we're going.

vocabulary.meaning_en: its = belongs to it; it's = it is
vocabulary.example: It's a nice cat; its fur is white.

vocabulary.meaning_en: their = belongs to them; they're = they are; there = in that place
vocabulary.example: They're at their house over there.

vocabulary.meaning_en: principal = the head of a school; principle = a moral rule you believe in
vocabulary.example: Our principal says honesty is an important principle.

vocabulary.meaning_en: hear = to listen with your ears; here = in this place
vocabulary.example: Can you hear me? I'm over here.

vocabulary.meaning_en: than = for comparing; then = at that time, next
vocabulary.note_ar: ليستا متطابقتين تمامًا في النطق لكنهما متقاربتان
vocabulary.note_en: Not exactly the same sound, but very close.
vocabulary.example: He is taller than me. I'll see you then.

vocabulary.meaning_en: buy = pay for; bye = goodbye; by = near, or how (by bus)
vocabulary.example: I went by bus to buy bread, then said bye.

vocabulary.meaning_en: more than is needed or wanted
vocabulary.example: This price is excessive; it's too much.

fine_lines.title: two / to / too
fine_lines.explanation_ar: two الرقم 2. to حرف جر للاتجاه (to the store) أو مع المصدر (to buy). too تعني أكثر من اللازم (too hot) أو أيضًا.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Two = the number. To = direction (to the store) or infinitive (to buy). Too = more than you want (too hot), or also.

examples.sentence: We're going to the store to buy milk.

fine_lines.title: your vs you're / its vs it's
fine_lines.explanation_ar: your وits للملكية بدون فاصلة علوية. you're = you are وit's = it is (اختصار بفاصلة علوية).
fine_lines.explanation_en: Your and its show possession (no apostrophe). You're = you are, it's = it is (apostrophe = letters missing).

fine_lines.title: their / they're / there
fine_lines.explanation_ar: their ملكية (بيتهم). they're = they are. there مكان (هناك).
fine_lines.explanation_en: Their = belongs to them. They're = they are. There = that place.

examples.sentence: I haven't lived there for 20 years.

fine_lines.title: principal vs principle
fine_lines.explanation_ar: principal مدير المدرسة. principle مبدأ أو قاعدة أخلاقية.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Principal = head of a school. Principle = a moral rule.

examples.sentence: The principal spoke to the students.
It's a matter of principle to tell the truth.

expressions.phrase: whether you like it or not
expressions.example: Whether you like it or not, we have a test tomorrow.
Put on the brakes; we're driving too fast.

expressions.meaning_en: something you do because you believe it is right
expressions.example: For me, being on time is a matter of principle.

grammar.title: Apostrophe = contraction, not possession (for pronouns)
grammar.explanation_ar: مع الضمائر، الفاصلة العلوية (') تعني حذف حروف وليس الملكية: it's = it is، you're = you are، they're = they are. أما ضمائر الملكية فلا فاصلة فيها: its, your, their.
grammar.explanation_en: With pronouns, the apostrophe shows missing letters, not possession: it's = it is, you're = you are, they're = they are. Possessive forms have no apostrophe: its, your, their.
examples: It's cold. The dog wants its blanket.
You're kind. Thank you for your help.
They're happy with their new flat.

questions.question: "Mr. E will meet me at the park if the ___ is nice."
"I need to ___ some milk and bread today."
"She told her worker ___ not open after 9 p.m."
"It's a matter of ___ to always tell the truth."
"My coffee is ___ hot. I can't drink it."
What is a homophone?
choices: A word written the same with a different meaning
A word that sounds the same as another but is different
questions.explanation_ar: homophone = نفس النطق ومعنى وكتابة مختلفان.
